description:
Responsibilities 
 Support the IT Infrastructure and their associated IT functionality tied to hardware/software configuration, administration, patching, and overall compliance.
 Provide architectural guidance for infrastructure functionality including cloud support, domain administrative functions, and vendor management (internal and external providers).
 Support the Engineering team PCS ASAT (PSAT) with respect to IT-related areas.
 Ensure HSS systems are compliant with documented standards and corporate security guidelines. 
 Coordinate with Engineering and Manufacturing leadership to support Smart Manufacturing projects.
 Responsible for assigned business IT ASAT areas.
 Participate on infrastructure projects to benefit the business unit’s technology posture.
 Coordinate with corporate support teams to support HSS business users.
 Maintain business client health (threat protection, software licenses and patch levels).
 Respond to emerging security threats when required.
 When required, travel to HSS locations to provide project support or any other site-related IT infrastructure support.
 Other duties as assigned.
 
 Qualifications 
 Must have a post-high school degree in computer science, information management, or related subject, and some level of practical experience.
 Three or more years of IT functional and technical experience specifically in standard IT infrastructure hardware (server/disk) technologies and software (VMsphere, MS Windows, RedHat LINUX, backup applications such as Veeam).
 Technical knowledge with the ability to understand code, debugging, and query writing is a plus.
 Understands IT best practices and industry proven practices and relates to Howmet specific business processes.
 Enthusiastic interest in learning and effectively applying new technologies for problem solving.
 Must possess effective verbal and written communication skills.
 Capable of traveling up to 20% both domestically and internationally.
 Metals industry process and system knowledge is a plus.
 Strong knowledge of network topologies and security administration of infrastructure is a plus.
 Knowledge of power shell scripting and ServiceNow is a plus.
 Working knowledge of engineering applications, processes, and sensitive data is a plus. 
 Knowledge of the programming of mobile devices and scanners is a plus.
   
 Let Your Career Take Flight at Howmet Aerospace! 
 We recognize and reward our employees’ contributions with a competitive total rewards package. This position offers:
 Medical/Prescription Drug/Dental/Vision Benefits on Day 1 of employment
 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan - 6% company match, plus additional 3% (whether you contribute or not), for a max total of 9% annually
 Paid Time Off (PTO)
 11 paid holidays per year
 Employee Life Insurance
 Employee Assistance Program
 Paid Parental Leave (up to 3 weeks of 100%-paid leave for parental bonding for the birth or adoption of a child)
  
 Joining our team means being part of a workplace that prioritizes professional development, collaboration, and a supportive culture designed to help you thrive.

 Compensation and Benefits: 

 If a pay range is identified for this job, it is based on a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. Actual compensation is subject to variation due to factors such as education, experience, skillset, market/business considerations, and/or location. 

 Howmet Aerospace offers a competitive benefits package to support the health, financial well-being, and professional growth of our employees. Benefits include: 

 

 
 Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision benefits coverage, including FSA and HSA account options 

 Pre-tax and Roth 401(k) retirement savings plans offering employer matching funds and a separate employer retirement contribution 

 Paid holidays and vacation time (eligibility, accrual, and usage are discretionary and governed by applicable policies)

 Paid parental leave and adoption assistance programs 

 Life insurance and disability coverage plans 

 Optional coverage plans for auto, home, legal, identity theft, and pet insurance 

 Tuition Assistance Program and ongoing professional development opportunities 

 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 

 
 Our Story: 

 Howmet Aerospace Inc. (NYSE: HWM), headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, is a leading global provider of advanced engineered solutions for the aerospace and transportation industries. Our primary businesses focus on jet engine components, aerospace fastening systems, titanium structural parts and forged wheels. With $8.3 Billion in revenue in 2025, our products play a crucial role in enabling fuel efficiency and lightweighting, contributing to our customers’ success and making a positive impact on the world. To learn more about the way Howmet Aerospace Inc. is advancing the sustainability of our customers, markets, and communities where we operate, review the 2025 Environmental Social and Governance report at www.howmet.com/esg-report . Follow: LinkedIn , Twitter , Instagram , Facebook , and YouTube .
